partners.mechanism_chain: HINT1 (HGNC:4756) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); LEF1 (HGNC:6577) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP47); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP47) —LEADS_TO→ Ectodermal dysplasia (HP:0000970); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP47) —LEADS_TO→ Limb malformation (HP:0001197); HINT1 (HGNC:4756) —DECREASES→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP47). Loss-of-function mutations in HINT1 cause Gamstorp-Wohlfart syndrome, leading to intellectual disability. HINT1 is known to interact with and modulate Wnt signaling. Mutations in LEF1, a key transcription factor in the Wnt pathway, cause ectodermal dysplasia with or without limb malformations. Therefore, dysregulation of the Wnt signaling pathway, potentially influenced by both HINT1 and LEF1, serves as a mechanistic link.

partners.mechanism_chain: APC variant leading to loss of function (None) —DISRUPTS→ APC (HGNC:424); APC (HGNC:424) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP522); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP522) —DISRUPTS→ CTNNB1 (HGNC:2515); CTNNB1 (HGNC:2515) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital nonprogressive muscle weakness (HP:0009074); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP522) —LEADS_TO→ Colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575). Loss-of-function variants in APC disrupt its normal function in regulating the Wnt signaling pathway. This disruption leads to the stabilization and accumulation of beta-catenin (encoded by CTNNB1), which in turn promotes the transcription of genes involved in cell proliferation and development. In the context of Gamstorp-Wohlfart syndrome, this leads to congenital nonprogressive muscle weakness. In colorectal cancer, the sustained activation of the Wnt pathway drives uncontrolled cell proliferation, contributing to tumor formation.

partners.diseaseBName: coloboma, osteopetrosis, microphthalmia, macrocephaly, albinism, and deafness
partners.mechanism_chain: HINT1 (HGNC:4909) —LEADS_TO→ Gamstorp-Wohlfart syndrome (MONDO:0007646); MITF (HGNC:7496) —DISRUPTS→ Melanogenesis (GO:0048054); Melanogenesis (GO:0048054) —DECREASES→ Transcription Regulation (GO:0006355); Transcription Regulation (GO:0006355) —DECREASES→ Cellular Differentiation (GO:0030154); Cellular Differentiation (GO:0030154) —LEADS_TO→ coloboma, osteopetrosis, microphthalmia, macrocephaly, albinism, and deafness (MONDO:0015014); MITF (HGNC:7496) —DISRUPTS→ Cellular Differentiation (GO:0030154).
